Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Honourable Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.3837 of 2020
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 by the petitioners, who are Accused No.1 and 2, seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.419 of 2020 on the file of Nawabpet Police Station, SPSR Nellore District.

entities.text: Nawabpet Police Station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The offences alleged are under Sections 188, 273, 328 of IPC and under Sections 58, 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act [for short FSS Act].
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners has placed reliance on the common order dated 18.12.2019 passed by a coordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.5421 of 2019 and batch, holding that "tobacco" does not fall within the definition of "food", as specified under Section 3(i)(j) of FSS Act, therefore, registration of FIR is not permissible.
Reliance has also been placed on the common order dated 05.03.2020 passed by another coordinate Bench of this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.5103 of 2019 and batch, quashing the FIRs therein.
In view of the aforesaid it is urged that FIR may be quashed against the petitioners herein.

4. On the other hand, though the Additional Public Prosecutor opposed the relief prayed for, he is not in a position to dispute the fact that various petitions filed before this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C. have been allowed and FIRs have been quashed, basing on the analogy put forth by the petitioners before this Court.

5. Considering the above and looking to the undisputed fact that previously FIRs have been quashed by this Court in similar matters, however, registration of FIR and proceedings with trial is wholly undesirable.
6. In that view of the matter, this Criminal Petition is allowed and FIR No.419 of 2020, dated 08.08.2020 on the file of Nawabpet Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, is hereby quashed

entities.text: Nawabpet Police Station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
;
consequently no further actions is necessary in the facts of the case.
As a sequel, the miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
